claim: 13 proteins, two deterministic arms (native and CAI-greedy). Not GATE-BEN-001: that gate needs at least 50 proteins and a LinearDesign or CDSfold arm scored on structure.mfe_global and usage.cai.
organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655
cross_check: thrL location 190..255 matches the prefix of an independent file headed '>NC_000913.3 Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655, complete genome' (beiko-lab/Expositor GCF_000005845.2_ASM584v2_genomic.fna). That file is truncated at 11680 nt, so later genes were checked only against their own location spans.

expression_evidence.citation: Li GW, Burkhardt D, Gross C, Weissman JS. Quantifying absolute protein synthesis rates reveals principles underlying allocation of cellular resources. Cell. 2014;157(3):624-635. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2014.02.033
expression_evidence.measured: absolute protein synthesis rate by ribosome profiling, covering more than 96% of proteins synthesized in that experiment
expression_evidence.why_null: The measurement exists for these genes. This file does not transcribe a number from the paper.

usage_reference.rule: Every CDS whose gene name starts with rpl, rps, or rpm. A class, not a numeric expression cutoff.
usage_reference.not: This is not the engine's usage.cai. That term refuses a genome-wide table, and this build does not invent the elongation rate a HostProfile would need in order to score the sequences through the landscape.

excluded.tufA: Annotated start is GTG. This build's translate() reads internal GTG as valine, so the panel keeps ATG-start CDS only.
excluded.gfp: No nucleotide CDS with an INSDC accession was reachable from this environment. A protein sequence was not reverse-translated.
